rainy.title: Guide for rainy days in Pilar.
rainy.subtitle: Precipitation is expected, making it ideal for indoor activities.
rainy.act1Desc: Stroll through covered shopping malls, the food court, and local stores.
rainy.act2Desc: Enjoy memorable theater productions or indoor entertainment and dining options.
rainy.act3Desc: An open yet sheltered environment, perfect for specialty cafes and boutique shopping.

cloudy.title: Guide for cloudy days in Pilar.
cloudy.subtitle: Cool and relaxed weather, ideal for peaceful walks and savoring local gastronomy.
cloudy.act1Desc: Enjoy a relaxed walk among retail stores, local design, and great gastronomy.
cloudy.act2Desc: A classic meeting spot to savor delicious coffee and connect with the heart of Pilar.

sunny.title: Guide for sunny days in Pilar.
sunny.subtitle: Make the most of the weather and enjoy outdoor activities.
sunny.act1Desc: Explore the historic center of Pilar, surrounded by centennial trees, colonial architecture, and local sights.
sunny.act2Desc: Ideal for nature walks, birdwatching, and breathing fresh air in a protected natural reserve.
sunny.act3Desc: Enjoy open green spaces, modern architecture, and exclusive dining spots for lunch or tea.
